<div class="msg"><small>Message</small><span>Password must not contain spaces.</span></div>

## Why it happens

The password policy under **Security > Security settings** sets a minimum and maximum length, how many uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits and special characters a password needs, and whether spaces are allowed.

## Fix it

Choose a password that meets every rule in the message. The message lists all the rules the password breaks.

## Check that it worked

The password is saved.
